_comment: Mobs (generated by tools/gen_mobs.py from archetype families, dungeon trash, named rares and bosses; the first 25 are the Phase 2 test-zone mobs, kept as they were). Stats are rules.mob_scaling times the multipliers; 'specials' are abilities and boss mechanics (see server content.hpp MobSpecial); 'biomes' tells tools/gen_world.py where camps of the mob belong; 'trade' and 'dungeon' tell tools/gen_items.py what the loot table drops.

specials.message: Rise, my subjects! Defend your king!
Enough dawdling! Back to work, all of you!
slams the ground; molten slag sprays out!
raises a skeletal hand. Dread washes over you!
fixes you with a petrifying stare.
calls down the storm! Lightning leaps from foe to foe!
The storm will not be denied!
The cavern floor heaves with roots!
You have wasted my time. Now you die.
There is no escape from my lair!
The Emberwyrm's fury knows no bounds!
